script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let v be call game:ai.stateSnippet.HpRateTransition.helper.retrieveRegisterAbilityConf.apply with (this state, arguments).
Let ability be this state → get-ability-id-from-conf with (arg, v).
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
If executer → is-in-reflection, then
  If not call game:ai.AiUtil.getIgnoresReflectionByAbilityId with (executer, ability), then
    Set v to _ → extend with ({}, v).
    Set v's 'abilityOptions' to _ → extend with ({}, v's 'abilityOptions', {activeTarget: executer}).
Return v.
